candidates.title: OpenAI Proposes Global 4-Day Work Week Policy
candidates.description: OpenAI published a 13-page policy document proposing a 32-hour work week at full pay, framing AI productivity gains as an 'efficiency dividend' for workers. The document also explores concepts like a public wealth fund and a 'robot tax' for companies replacing human roles with AI.
candidates.significance: This proposal from a leading AI company could significantly influence future labor policies and economic models globally as AI integration transforms the workforce.

candidates.title: China Blocks Meta's $2 Billion Acquisition of AI Startup Manus
candidates.description: Beijing blocked Meta’s attempt to acquire the agentic AI startup Manus, citing national security concerns and a desire to prevent advanced AI technology from flowing to the U.S. This decision came ahead of high-level diplomatic meetings.
candidates.significance: This event highlights the escalating geopolitical competition over AI technology, indicating a long-term trend of national interests dictating cross-border AI mergers and acquisitions, reshaping the global AI industry landscape.

candidates.title: Google Breaks Ground on Gigawatt-Scale AI Hub in India with $15 Billion Investment
candidates.description: Google officially commenced construction on a landmark gigawatt-scale AI hub in Visakhapatnam, India. This is part of a broader $15 billion investment planned from 2026–2030, aimed at establishing a comprehensive AI ecosystem in the region.
candidates.significance: This massive investment and infrastructure development will significantly boost India's role in the global AI landscape, fostering local talent, research, and potentially shifting geographical centers of AI innovation over the next five years and beyond.

candidates.title: Russia Establishes 'Closed' National AI Hub at Moscow State University
candidates.description: Reports confirmed the completion of a 'closed' AI hub at Moscow State University, centered around Katerina Tikhonova. The hub consolidates AI research, a new faculty, and the MGU-270 supercomputer, signifying a strategic national effort in AI development.
candidates.significance: This centralized, state-backed AI hub signals Russia's long-term commitment to developing advanced AI capabilities independently, potentially leading to distinct technological advancements and influencing the global geopolitical balance of AI power.
